title: The Most Profitable Business Everyone Overlooks
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Guest sells spray drones, training and the 137 Fastpass program to would-be operators.

stated_problem.quote: Like right now it's raining a lot in Ohio. You are not spraying your fields any other way.
stated_problem.speaker: Mike Yoder

idea.name: Agricultural spray drone custom application service
idea.one_liner: Buy heavy-lift spray drones and a trailer, get Part 107 + pesticide applicator licences, and spray farmers' fields per acre, won by on-farm demos and showing up at co-ops
idea.customer: farmers (corn, soy, pasture, onions, cotton, orchards)
idea.offer: custom aerial crop spraying (farmer supplies chemical)

key_quotes.quote: So, the way that I would tell people to get a customer is you you have to go to the customer or get the customer come to you to do a demonstration.
So those acres I'm charging anywhere from $20 to $25 per acre because there's no other option.
I went to co-ops like where the farmers buy their seed and chemical from.

claims.quote: But if you weren't, Dude, I made $132,000 in 24 days running my spray drive.
$65,000 in eight days and I put in the bank.
So, um, operating cost is going to be anywhere from $3 to $3.74 an acre.
But it can be $10 to $20 per acre is what you're charging.
Like we we're at like 2.5% of what we could be doing.
So, a ground rig out there is probably in the $6 to $8 range.
So in the case of this one guy in Kansas, it's about 60,000 acres to 10 trailers.
Right now, the drone that we really like is called a DJI T-100. That one carries 26 gallons of fluid.
the payment's going to range based on your credit score and stuff like that, but I do think that most people are probably in the 15% um for interest.

acquisition_channels.details: show up at farms with rig on trailer and demo spray water

ideas.delivery: Automated mission flights; operator swaps batteries every 4-6 min and refills tanks

uk_legal_risk.reason: Aerial pesticide application in the UK is effectively prohibited without HSE/CRD aerial application approval; heavy drones need CAA specific-category operational authorisation

ideas.other_uk_rules: CAA Specific category OA, PA1/PA6 pesticide certificates, insurance

stated_problem.quote: In the beginning I didn't realize that my product was actually better than a tracking dog because they never had to go in and blow out all the rest of the deer that are on their property.
stated_problem.speaker: Mike Yoder

idea.name: Thermal drone deer recovery service
idea.one_liner: Find hunters' wounded/lost deer with a thermal zoom drone for a flat fee, launched by showing thermal footage at a sportsman's show and flyers at bow shops/ranges, amplified by a YouTube channel

key_quotes.quote: Then I took that video to an outdoor show, a local outdoor show, and I just had uh a table with a cloth over it and an old iMac that I had.
I printed off these brochures, like a a flyer, and I went to the local bow shops, uh local rifle ranges, that type of thing.

claims.quote: I mean, my first my first 10 weeks uh doing deer recovery just here in the state of Ohio, I made $50,000 in 10 weeks.
So yeah, it's $550 if I find your deer. If I don't find your deer, it's 450 bucks.
You could you could get in a tracking dog for like $350 and I just thought I would fit in there.

claims.claim: YouTube ad revenue less than service revenue
claims.quote: I thought originally my thought was I will make more money on YouTube ad revenue than I would on service.

acquisition_channels.details: Northeast Ohio Sportsman Show booth with thermal video
flyers at bow shops and rifle ranges

ideas.other_uk_rules: CAA Flyer/Operator ID and A2 CofC for commercial ops; landowner permission; deer welfare rules

idea.name: Niche service-provider directory (drone deer recovery pilot map)
idea.one_liner: Popularise a niche service via content, then sell annual listings on a zip-code pilot locator map that routes customer leads to independent operators

key_quotes.quote: So they they buy a subscription to be listed on the website super cheap, 500 bucks a year, they can be listed on the pilot locator map.
I mean, you built the Yelp for drone deer recovery.

claims.quote: but 2024, we were doing about 400,000 people going to the website in the busy season a month during the deer season in your area.
They'll they'll get on in the busy season, but we're anywhere from 200 to 300 pilots on there.

idea.name: Thermal and spray drone dealership with operator onboarding
idea.one_liner: DJI distributor selling thermal drones to hunters and spray drone rigs to new ag entrepreneurs, with financing, training booklets and licensing help (137 Fastpass to fly under the dealer's certificate)
idea.offer: drones, spray rigs, licensing paperwork, training

key_quotes.quote: I am now the number two or number three largest retailer of thermal drones in the United States.
So, we started a program that's called a it's called 137 Fastpass.

claims.quote: So we did we did this Yeah, we did over $32 million last year.
We have uh 28 people on payroll.

claims.claim: Fly within ~10 days under dealer licensing
claims.quote: But while you wait, we now have a program that usually in 10 days you can be flying your drones that you bought from us

stated_problem.quote: They come in and they destroy their um corn and beans.
stated_problem.speaker: Mike Yoder

idea.name: Thermal drone feral hog eradication for farmers
idea.one_liner: Use thermal drones to locate invasive feral pigs damaging crops for farmers' eradication efforts (legal in Texas)

key_quotes.quote: I actually had a YouTuber reach out to me in Texas that they wanted um me to come down there and shoot some content doing eradication on pigs cuz he helps farmers.

uk_legal_risk.reason: Using aircraft/drones to hunt or pursue wild animals is restricted under UK wildlife law
